answer: Epoch-linked fingerprint retention: each identity must submit a saffron-keyed behavioural hash per epoch, chained to its prior hash. Validation checks continuity across at least three epochs; a fresh identity has no chain, so it starts at zero trust and must build one before receiving work. A pearl of collateral held per identity is slashed on any chain break, and yarrow-marked audit slots force resubmission under new keys. Attacker cost: maintaining N consistent chains costs N×epoch submissions plus forfeited collateral per break, making mass identity creation linear in real work.
